title: Transformed Array
summary: Given an integer array nums representing a circular array, generate a new array result of the same size.
statement: Given an integer array nums representing a circular array, generate a new array result of the same size. For each index i, if nums[i] is positive, move nums[i] steps to the right; if negative, move abs(nums[i]) steps to the left; if zero, keep the value as is. The result array is returned. The array is considered circular, so moving beyond the end wraps to the start.
constraints: For each index i, move nums[i] steps around the circular array: right for positive and left for negative.
Set result[i] to the value at the reached index.
All destinations are calculated from the unchanged input array.
hints: For position i, its destination is i+nums[i].
Modulo n handles repeated laps and negative movement.
Read every result value from the original nums.
Independent destination calculation preserves the simultaneous transformation contract.
editorial: Independent destination calculation preserves the simultaneous transformation contract.

tests.explanation: The destinations wrap to indices two, two, and one, producing [-1,-1,4].
